title: Turbulent channel flow at Re_τ 182, 543 and 1000 against direct numerical simulation (Lee and Moser)
source: M. Lee and R. D. Moser, Direct numerical simulation of turbulent channel flow up to Re_τ ≈ 5200, J. Fluid Mech. 774:395–415 (2015), doi:10.1017/jfm.2015.268; Re_τ 182.088, 543.496 and 1000.512 mean-profile data, u_τ and the bulk velocity from each file's header
requires: the Spalart–Allmaras wall law on the half-way wall with the regularised collision; each row is run by that feature's heavy test on one CPU thread, 40,000 to 110,000 steps

quantities.quantity: skin friction C_f = 2 (u_τ/U_b)² of the turbulent channel at Re_τ 182.088, 10 cells per half-height
quantities.reason: 1 % on the bulk-velocity friction coefficient: the DNS reference is a time average to about 0.1 %, and a wall model that works should be within a percent
quantities.known_failure: FieldCraft's value is 8.039611e-03, -1.03 % from the reference, outside the 1 % bar; reported, not tuned away

regression.reason: our own result at the commit that recorded it (settled run, drag balances the body force to 5e-5): a later change that moves it by more than 0.05 % must say why
